# 0. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(progress)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(glmnet)
library(e1071)
library(randomForest)
library(gbm)

set.seed(params$seed)

to_class_factor <- function(y01, pos_label = "pos", neg_label = "neg") {
  y01 <- as.integer(y01)
  factor(ifelse(y01 == 1, pos_label, neg_label), levels = c(pos_label, neg_label))
}

enforce_class_levels <- function(d) {
  d$Class <- factor(d$Class, levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))
  d
}

calc_binary_metrics <- function(obs, prob, threshold, pos_label = params$positive_label, neg_label = params$negative_label) {
  pred <- factor(ifelse(prob >= threshold, pos_label, neg_label), levels = c(pos_label, neg_label))
  obs  <- factor(obs, levels = c(pos_label, neg_label))

  tp <- sum(pred == pos_label & obs == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  tn <- sum(pred == neg_label & obs == neg_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  fp <- sum(pred == pos_label & obs == neg_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  fn <- sum(pred == neg_label & obs == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  n  <- tp + tn + fp + fn

  tibble(
    tp = tp,
    tn = tn,
    fp = fp,
    fn = fn,
    accuracy = ifelse(n > 0, (tp + tn) / n, NA_real_),
    sensitivity = ifelse((tp + fn) > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA_real_),
    specificity = ifelse((tn + fp) > 0, tn / (tn + fp), NA_real_),
    precision = ifelse((tp + fp) > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA_real_),
    npv = ifelse((tn + fn) > 0, tn / (tn + fn), NA_real_),
    false_positive_rate = ifelse((fp + tn) > 0, fp / (fp + tn), NA_real_),
    false_negative_rate = ifelse((fn + tp) > 0, fn / (fn + tp), NA_real_),
    predicted_positive_rate = ifelse(n > 0, (tp + fp) / n, NA_real_),
    predicted_positive_count = tp + fp
  )
}

apply_imbalance <- function(train_df) {
  train_df$Class <- factor(train_df$Class, levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))
  out <- caret::upSample(
    x = train_df %>% dplyr::select(-Class),
    y = train_df$Class,
    yname = "Class"
  )
  out$Class <- factor(out$Class, levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))
  out %>% dplyr::slice_sample(prop = 1)
}

ctrl_cv <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = params$cv_folds,
  repeats = params$cv_repeats,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  allowParallel = FALSE,
  verboseIter = FALSE
)
```

# 1. Load and prepare data

```{r load-data}
if (grepl("\\.csv$", params$data_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  data1 <- read.csv(params$data_file)
} else {
  stop("data_file must be a .csv file")
}

if ("DEM" %in% names(data1)) {
  data1 <- data1[!is.na(data1$DEM), ]
  data1 <- data1[data1$DEM != 0, ]
}

variables <- c(
  "new_arsenic", "DensityWel", "Curvature", "DistBrown", "DisHazSite", "DistlnaHaS",
  "DisRUST", "Slope", "TPI", "TRI", "TWI", "DEM", "DisALa", "DisDam", "DisCoalAsh",
  "Zinc", "Hardness", "Alkalinity", "Sodium", "Calcium", "Sulfate", "Nitrate",
  "Fluoride", "Iron", "Magnesium", "Manganese", "Chloride", "Barium", "mica",
  "newPH", "AutoCov"
)

vars_present <- intersect(variables, names(data1))
data_extracted <- data1[, vars_present, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(params$target %in% names(data_extracted))
data_extracted[[params$target]] <- as.integer(data_extracted[[params$target]])
```

```{r impute-and-class}
y <- data_extracted[[params$target]]
X <- data_extracted %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(params$target))

for (nm in names(X)) {
  if (is.numeric(X[[nm]]) || is.integer(X[[nm]])) {
    med <- median(X[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
    X[[nm]][is.na(X[[nm]])] <- med
  } else {
    X[[nm]] <- as.factor(X[[nm]])
    mode_val <- names(sort(table(X[[nm]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    X[[nm]][is.na(X[[nm]])] <- mode_val
  }
}

df_base <- bind_cols(X, !!params$target := y)
df_base$Class <- to_class_factor(df_base[[params$target]], params$positive_label, params$negative_label)
df_base <- df_base %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(params$target))
original_features <- setdiff(names(df_base), "Class")
```

# 2. Build full mode and interpretable mode datasets

## 2.1 Full mode

```{r full-mode}
df_full <- df_base

# interpretable ratios
if (all(c("Calcium", "Magnesium") %in% names(df_full))) {
  df_full$Ca_Mg_ratio <- df_full$Calcium / (df_full$Magnesium + 0.01)
}
if (all(c("Sodium", "Chloride") %in% names(df_full))) {
  df_full$Na_Cl_ratio <- df_full$Sodium / (df_full$Chloride + 0.01)
}
if (all(c("Iron", "Manganese") %in% names(df_full))) {
  df_full$Fe_Mn_ratio <- df_full$Iron / (df_full$Manganese + 0.001)
}

# log transforms
log_candidates <- c()
for (nm in original_features) {
  if (is.numeric(df_full[[nm]])) {
    skew_val <- e1071::skewness(df_full[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(skew_val) && abs(skew_val) > 1) log_candidates <- c(log_candidates, nm)
  }
}
for (nm in unique(log_candidates)) {
  min_val <- min(df_full[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
  offset <- ifelse(min_val <= 0, abs(min_val) + 1, 0)
  df_full[[paste0("log_", nm)]] <- log(df_full[[nm]] + offset)
}

# squared terms
poly_candidates <- intersect(c("DEM", "Slope", "TWI", "TPI", "TRI", "Hardness",
                               "Alkalinity", "Sulfate", "Nitrate", "newPH"), names(df_full))
for (nm in poly_candidates) {
  if (is.numeric(df_full[[nm]])) df_full[[paste0(nm, "_sq")]] <- df_full[[nm]]^2
}

# more ratios
if (all(c("Sulfate", "Chloride") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$SO4_Cl_ratio <- df_full$Sulfate / (df_full$Chloride + 0.01)
if (all(c("Hardness", "Alkalinity") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$Hard_Alk_ratio <- df_full$Hardness / (df_full$Alkalinity + 0.01)
if (all(c("Nitrate", "Sulfate") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$NO3_SO4_ratio <- df_full$Nitrate / (df_full$Sulfate + 0.01)
if (all(c("TRI", "TPI") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$TRI_TPI_ratio <- df_full$TRI / (abs(df_full$TPI) + 0.01)
if (all(c("Slope", "TWI") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$Slope_TWI_ratio <- df_full$Slope / (df_full$TWI + 0.01)

# interactions
if (all(c("DEM", "DistBrown") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$DEM_x_DistBrown <- df_full$DEM * df_full$DistBrown
if (all(c("Slope", "TWI") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$Slope_x_TWI <- df_full$Slope * df_full$TWI
if (all(c("DEM", "TWI") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$DEM_x_TWI <- df_full$DEM * df_full$TWI
if (all(c("newPH", "Hardness") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$pH_x_Hardness <- df_full$newPH * df_full$Hardness
if (all(c("newPH", "Iron") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$pH_x_Iron <- df_full$newPH * df_full$Iron
if (all(c("Alkalinity", "newPH") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$Alk_x_pH <- df_full$Alkalinity * df_full$newPH
if (all(c("DensityWel", "Nitrate") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$WellDens_x_Nitrate <- df_full$DensityWel * df_full$Nitrate
if (all(c("DisHazSite", "Iron") %in% names(df_full))) df_full$HazSite_x_Iron <- df_full$DisHazSite * df_full$Iron

for (nm in names(df_full)) {
  if (is.numeric(df_full[[nm]])) {
    df_full[[nm]][is.infinite(df_full[[nm]])] <- NA
    df_full[[nm]][is.nan(df_full[[nm]])] <- NA
    if (any(is.na(df_full[[nm]]))) df_full[[nm]][is.na(df_full[[nm]])] <- median(df_full[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r full-feature-selection}
df_full$Class <- factor(df_full$Class, levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))

nzv <- nearZeroVar(df_full %>% dplyr::select(-Class), saveMetrics = TRUE)
nzv_remove <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
if (length(nzv_remove) > 0) {
  df_full <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(nzv_remove))
}

is_engineered <- function(x) grepl("^log_", x) | grepl("_sq$", x) | grepl("_x_", x) | grepl("_ratio$", x)
removal_priority <- function(x) ifelse(is_engineered(x), 1L, 0L)

numeric_cols <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(-Class) %>% dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))
if (ncol(numeric_cols) >= 2) {
  cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_cols, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cn <- colnames(cor_matrix)
  to_remove <- character(0)
  pr <- setNames(removal_priority(cn), cn)
  cutoff <- 0.95

  for (j in 2:length(cn)) {
    for (k in 1:(j - 1)) {
      v1 <- cn[k]; v2 <- cn[j]
      if (v1 %in% to_remove || v2 %in% to_remove) next
      r <- cor_matrix[v1, v2]
      if (is.na(r)) next
      if (abs(r) >= cutoff) {
        if (pr[v1] > pr[v2]) {
          to_remove <- c(to_remove, v1)
        } else if (pr[v2] > pr[v1]) {
          to_remove <- c(to_remove, v2)
        } else {
          avg1 <- mean(abs(cor_matrix[v1, ]), na.rm = TRUE)
          avg2 <- mean(abs(cor_matrix[v2, ]), na.rm = TRUE)
          to_remove <- c(to_remove, ifelse(avg1 >= avg2, v1, v2))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(unique(to_remove)) > 0) {
    df_full <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(unique(to_remove)))
  }
}
```

## 2.2 Interpretable mode (used as simplified mode)

```{r interpretable-mode}
df_interpretable <- df_base

message("Using INTERPRETABLE features only (no complex transformations)")

if (all(c("Calcium", "Magnesium") %in% names(df_interpretable))) {
  df_interpretable$Ca_Mg_ratio <- df_interpretable$Calcium / (df_interpretable$Magnesium + 0.01)
}
if (all(c("Sodium", "Chloride") %in% names(df_interpretable))) {
  df_interpretable$Na_Cl_ratio <- df_interpretable$Sodium / (df_interpretable$Chloride + 0.01)
}
if (all(c("Iron", "Manganese") %in% names(df_interpretable))) {
  df_interpretable$Fe_Mn_ratio <- df_interpretable$Iron / (df_interpretable$Manganese + 0.001)
}

for (nm in names(df_interpretable)) {
  if (is.numeric(df_interpretable[[nm]])) {
    df_interpretable[[nm]][is.infinite(df_interpretable[[nm]])] <- NA
    if (any(is.na(df_interpretable[[nm]]))) {
      df_interpretable[[nm]][is.na(df_interpretable[[nm]])] <- median(df_interpretable[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

new_features_interpretable <- setdiff(names(df_interpretable), c(original_features, "Class"))
message("Added ", length(new_features_interpretable), " interpretable ratio features: ",
        paste(new_features_interpretable, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r interpretable-feature-selection}
df_interpretable$Class <- factor(df_interpretable$Class, levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))
message("Interpretable mode: skipping complex feature selection")

nzv_i <- nearZeroVar(df_interpretable %>% dplyr::select(-Class), saveMetrics = TRUE)
nzv_remove_i <- rownames(nzv_i)[nzv_i$nzv]

if (length(nzv_remove_i) > 0) {
  message("Removing ", length(nzv_remove_i), " near-zero variance features")
  df_interpretable <- df_interpretable %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(nzv_remove_i))
}
```

# 3. Build the three final package datasets

```{r package-datasets}
full_df <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(Class, dplyr::everything()) %>% enforce_class_levels()
simplified_df <- df_interpretable %>% dplyr::select(Class, dplyr::everything()) %>% enforce_class_levels()

package_specs <- tribble(
  ~package_name,           ~dataset_name,    ~model_name, ~threshold,
  "Screening-First",      "simplified",   "glmnet",   0.2,
  "Confirmation-First",   "full",         "rf",       0.5,
  "Explanation-First",    "simplified",   "rf",       0.3
)

package_specs
```

# 4. Repeated evaluation for the three final packages only

```{r run-packages, warning=FALSE, message=TRUE}
package_results <- tibble()
package_predictions <- tibble()

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "[:bar] :percent | elapsed: :elapsed | eta: :eta | :message",
  total = nrow(package_specs) * params$n_times,
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 70
)

for (pkg_i in seq_len(nrow(package_specs))) {
  pkg <- package_specs[pkg_i, ]

  df_model <- if (pkg$dataset_name == "full") full_df else simplified_df
  df_model <- enforce_class_levels(df_model)
  row_ids <- seq_len(nrow(df_model))

  for (i in seq_len(params$n_times)) {
    idx_train <- createDataPartition(df_model$Class, p = 1 - params$test_prop, list = FALSE)
    train0 <- df_model[idx_train, ] %>% enforce_class_levels()
    test0  <- df_model[-idx_train, ] %>% enforce_class_levels()
    test_ids <- row_ids[-idx_train]

    train_bal <- apply_imbalance(train0)

    set.seed(params$seed + pkg_i * 1000 + i)

    fit <- tryCatch({
      if (pkg$model_name == "glmnet") {
        caret::train(
          Class ~ .,
          data = train_bal,
          method = "glmnet",
          metric = "ROC",
          trControl = ctrl_cv,
          tuneLength = params$tune_length,
          preProcess = c("center", "scale")
        )
      } else if (pkg$model_name == "rf") {
        caret::train(
          Class ~ .,
          data = train_bal,
          method = "rf",
          metric = "ROC",
          trControl = ctrl_cv,
          tuneLength = params$tune_length
        )
      } else {
        stop("Unsupported model")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Package %s failed on iter %d: %s", pkg$package_name, i, e$message))
      NULL
    })

    if (is.null(fit)) {
      pb$tick(1, tokens = list(message = sprintf("%s | iter %d FAILED", pkg$package_name, i)))
      next
    }

    probs <- predict(fit, newdata = test0, type = "prob")[[params$positive_label]]
    auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(
      pROC::roc(test0$Class, probs,
                levels = c(params$negative_label, params$positive_label),
                direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
    ))

    m <- calc_binary_metrics(test0$Class, probs, pkg$threshold) %>%
      mutate(
        package_name = pkg$package_name,
        dataset_name = pkg$dataset_name,
        model_name = pkg$model_name,
        iter = i,
        auc = auc_val
      )

    package_results <- bind_rows(package_results, m)

    package_predictions <- bind_rows(
      package_predictions,
      tibble(
        package_name = pkg$package_name,
        dataset_name = pkg$dataset_name,
        model_name = pkg$model_name,
        threshold = pkg$threshold,
        iter = i,
        row_id = test_ids,
        truth = test0$Class,
        prob = probs,
        pred_class = factor(ifelse(probs >= pkg$threshold, params$positive_label, params$negative_label),
                            levels = c(params$positive_label, params$negative_label))
      )
    )

    pb$tick(1, tokens = list(message = sprintf("%s | iter %d done", pkg$package_name, i)))
  }
}
```

# 5. Package comparison summary

```{r package-summary}
package_summary <- package_results %>%
  group_by(package_name, dataset_name, model_name) %>%
  summarise(
    threshold = first(package_specs$threshold[match(first(package_name), package_specs$package_name)]),
    n_iter = dplyr::n(),
    mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_auc = sd(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sensitivity = mean(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_specificity = mean(specificity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_npv = mean(npv, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fpr = mean(false_positive_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fnr = mean(false_negative_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_predicted_positive_count = mean(predicted_positive_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

package_summary
```

```{r package-metric-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
plot_df <- package_summary %>%
  select(package_name, mean_sensitivity, mean_specificity, mean_precision) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean_"), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
                         mean_sensitivity = "Sensitivity",
                         mean_specificity = "Specificity",
                         mean_precision = "Precision"))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = package_name, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Three final packages: key decision metrics",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
```

# 6. Final models for package maps

```{r fit-final-package-models}
fit_final_package <- function(df_model, model_name) {
  train_bal <- apply_imbalance(df_model)

  if (model_name == "glmnet") {
    caret::train(
      Class ~ .,
      data = train_bal,
      method = "glmnet",
      metric = "ROC",
      trControl = ctrl_cv,
      tuneLength = params$tune_length,
      preProcess = c("center", "scale")
    )
  } else if (model_name == "rf") {
    caret::train(
      Class ~ .,
      data = train_bal,
      method = "rf",
      metric = "ROC",
      trControl = ctrl_cv,
      tuneLength = params$tune_length
    )
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported model")
  }
}

final_fits <- list(
  screening = fit_final_package(simplified_df, "glmnet"),
  confirmation = fit_final_package(full_df, "rf"),
  explanation = fit_final_package(simplified_df, "rf")
)
```

# 7. Binary package maps (Exceedance / No Exceedance)

```{r map-setup}
stopifnot("X" %in% names(data1), "Y" %in% names(data1))
coords_df <- data1 %>% dplyr::select(X, Y)
stopifnot(nrow(coords_df) == nrow(df_base))

gaston_outline <- st_read(params$outline_shp, quiet = TRUE)

map_df_screening <- bind_cols(coords_df, simplified_df)
map_df_confirmation <- bind_cols(coords_df, full_df)
map_df_explanation <- bind_cols(coords_df, simplified_df)

pred_screening <- predict(final_fits$screening,
                          newdata = map_df_screening %>% select(-X, -Y, -Class),
                          type = "prob")[[params$positive_label]]
pred_confirmation <- predict(final_fits$confirmation,
                             newdata = map_df_confirmation %>% select(-X, -Y, -Class),
                             type = "prob")[[params$positive_label]]
pred_explanation <- predict(final_fits$explanation,
                            newdata = map_df_explanation %>% select(-X, -Y, -Class),
                            type = "prob")[[params$positive_label]]

package_map_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(X = coords_df$X, Y = coords_df$Y,
         package_name = "Screening-First",
         threshold = 0.2,
         prob = pred_screening),
  tibble(X = coords_df$X, Y = coords_df$Y,
         package_name = "Confirmation-First",
         threshold = 0.5,
         prob = pred_confirmation),
  tibble(X = coords_df$X, Y = coords_df$Y,
         package_name = "Explanation-First",
         threshold = 0.3,
         prob = pred_explanation)
) %>%
  mutate(
    status = ifelse(prob >= threshold, "Exceedance", "No exceedance"),
    status = factor(status, levels = c("No exceedance", "Exceedance"))
  )

package_map_sf <- st_as_sf(package_map_df, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 4326)
package_map_sf <- st_transform(package_map_sf, st_crs(gaston_outline))
```

```{r binary-package-maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = gaston_outline, fill = "grey95", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = package_map_sf, aes(color = status), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("No exceedance" = "steelblue", "Exceedance" = "red3"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ package_name, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Binary package maps: exceedance vs no exceedance",
    subtitle = "Final package settings applied to Gaston County well locations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

  group_by(package_name) %>%
